name: 클로에
visual_review: 클로에의 회갈색 머리·나른한 눈·갈색 드레스와 작은 은회색 니나 인형을 12셀 모두 유지했습니다. 손가락 조종·생명 연결·니나 도약과 회전·착지·실 회수가 구분됩니다.
motion_summary: Chloe long ash-brown hair, gentle sleepy red-gray eyes, brown-white dress and white bow exactly from identity. Include her unique doll Nina visible in portrait at lower-right: a smaller gray-white-haired mechanical marionette with bladed legs and pale frilled doll dress, clearly a doll not a duplicate human Chloe. Both in every cell. Official R links Chloe and Nina, speeds doll and shares life. Animate paired idle; Chloe raises puppeteer hand; fingers spread and thin crimson-white strings reach Nina; Nina leans forward; Chloe steps back and two red-white heartlike light points join through taut life link; Nina short forward leap; doll turns with one bladed leg extending, Chloe's elbow pulls strings; strong horizontal life-link pulse between them below face height; Nina lands back near her; strings slacken; Chloe lowers hand; original paired idle. Actual doll legs/torso and Chloe wrist/arm movement, not stationary aura. No generic robot or teddy bear.
